title: comfy generate
description: Terminal result of `comfy generate <model>`, `comfy generate resume <id>`, and sync-mode creates, in JSON/NDJSON modes: the partner's final response body wrapped as `result` (verbatim, so provider-specific fields survive), plus `saved` local paths when --download produced files. Failures do not use this schema — they arrive as an ok=false envelope with a registered error.code.

result.description: The partner API's final response payload, unmodified.

saved.description: Local paths written by --download, in URL order. Absent when --download was not passed or produced nothing.
